full_page.content:
Pg. 31. Handwritten notes Retreat 1944 St. Bonaventure - Fr. Alponse Pittsburg
Conferences
I. Opening - Opportunity - use cooperation
Monday Oct. 9.
I. "Be ye Perfect, as your Father in Heaven is P." Matt. I Obligation to strive for perfection.
II. "The Obedient man shall speak of Victories :.
III. "Death" - At once most certain and most uncertain.
IV. "Loyalty to Friends - to the Order." - Disl'y.
Tuesd'y
I. Appreciation - Gratitude
II. Chastity .. Blessed are the pure of H.
III. Charitable thinking ...
IV. "Mind Thy own business
Wednesday I
II. Chastity .... Bl'd are the clean of heart ...
III. Mary, Mother of God: Our Mother, our Refuge.
TH.
I. Excellency of Francisca - Our - Rule - mode of life saving our souls
II. He that exalteth himself shall be humbled. He that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
III. "Amen Except you Eat the flesh of the Son of Man you shall not have life in you". John VI.
Pg. 32. Retreat October 13th 1951 Introduction - Necessity of self-review - self check up etc. at least now and
(No further notes here)
